checks.expected: no exact duplicate rows (duplicates are kept either way)

duplicates.note: Exact duplicate rows are counted but kept. The file has no customer identifier and its columns are coarse (several are binary or binned), so two different customers can have identical rows; dropping them would remove real customers and bias the arm sizes.
